text: Hi, I moved to Koramangala recently.
Welcome to Koramangala! I have noted your area preference.
Can you help me arrange services for my apartment?
Certainly! I can help you find and book verified plumbers, electricians, and AC technicians.
Do you need my approval before booking anything?
Yes, always. I will never perform any booking, cancellation, or reschedule without your explicit approval.
I usually prefer morning slots before 12pm on weekdays.
Noted! Morning weekday preference is saved to your memory.
Also I have a pet dog at home.
Understood. I will make sure technicians are aware of your pet.
Thanks! Last week I booked an electrician named Sparky Electrical Works.
Yes, your booking BKG-PAST-001 with Sparky Electrical Works is in your booking history.
Great. What is my current budget limit for plumbing?
Your preferred plumbing budget is up to ₹1,500.
